query.text: 请帮我记住物品放在哪里，当我找东西遇到困难时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please help me remember where things are placed and remind me when I have trouble finding something.

annotation.text_zh: 您刚才把红色盒子放进床头柜抽屉里了。
annotation.text_en: You just put the red box in the nightstand drawer.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
